status: Design only; not approval to store real conversations or change schema

existingFoundation.conversationAndMessageModels: Absent in the current Prisma schema
existingFoundation.currentStorage: Existing conversation/comparison buckets in scoped sessionStorage; 30 minute TTL; no new storage backend
existingFoundation.scope: Web showroom namespace plus server-generated tenant, staff user and auth-session hash; guests have tab-local context only, no authenticated customer identity
existingFoundation.channel: Web only. No WhatsApp or Telegram transport
existingFoundation.inquiryWorkflow: Existing public inquiry route and submitPublicInquiry create Inquiry and InquiryItems using tenant-bound public variants and creationKey/hash idempotency. Both intake gates remain closed
existingFoundation.receipt: The public route deliberately returns only ok:true after persistence completes; a client-side inquiry ID or receipt must never be treated as ownership authorization

localCandidate.change: Store up to three selected slot/product/execution/variant references in the existing conversation payload, recover their public product links in the unsent handoff summary, and hide references whose variant is no longer selected
localCandidate.trust: Identifiers are untrusted restoration hints. Existing server public tools must revalidate tenant, publication, branch, variant and availability before inquiry submission

durableHistoryProposal.decisionRequired: Approve purpose, retention, user notice and guest ownership policy before implementation or any live storage
durableHistoryProposal.minimalNoticeProposal: Сохранить этот диалог на 7 дней и передать выбранные вещи и пожелания сотруднику MARIPOSA, когда я нажму «Передать сотруднику». Можно продолжить без сохранения. Не указывайте документы, платёжные данные или секреты.
durableHistoryProposal.consent: Separate optional, unchecked choice; separate explicit handoff action. No inferred or retroactive consent. Wording and seven-day retention require business approval; this file does not establish a legal basis
durableHistoryProposal.identity: Conversation ownership comes from server-verified tenant and authenticated customer principal, or an opaque server-issued guest capability in an HttpOnly cookie whose hash is stored server-side. Never accept customerId, organizationId or ownerId from a request body. Do not repurpose staff AuthSession as a customer conversation
durableHistoryProposal.schemaDesignOnly: If approved: one tenant-bound Conversation with channel WEB, exactly one guest/customer owner, expiry and optional tenant-safe Inquiry link; ordered bounded Message rows owned through the same Conversation. Do not create a parallel inquiry/contact pipeline
durableHistoryProposal.handoff: In one transaction, verify conversation ownership and consent, revalidate selected public product/variant IDs, derive a bounded preference summary and call the existing Inquiry workflow with idempotency. Link the resulting Inquiry server-side only after creation; mark handoff complete only after commit. Public receipt must not expose staff/customer data
durableHistoryProposal.restoration: Authorize every read by tenant+channel+owner; return only permitted transcript/preferences/IDs. Revalidate products on demand; never restore saved availability as current or automatically call the model
durableHistoryProposal.retention: Proposed seven-day conversation expiry with message deletion. Existing operational Inquiry retention is a separate business rule; do not silently delete or extend it
isolatedTestsRequiredBeforeActivation: No guest-to-customer merge without verified explicit ownership transfer
Concurrent handoff retry creates one Inquiry
No consent means no durable transcript
